chemistry_notes: Two-stage oxidative amidation. Stage 1 (5 mL) oxidizes benzyl alcohol to benzoyl intermediate using TBHP/NaBr/H2SO4. Stage 2 (10 mL) amidates with morpholine added at interstage. TBHP and morpholine are incompatible and must be segregated. Thermal reaction at 80°C. No light source required. PFA tubing used for thermal stability. BPR set to 5 bar as precautionary measure due to operating temperature close to solvent boiling point (dioxane bp 101°C).
